import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before = copy.deepcopy((req, ev, pol))
    got = evaluate(req, ev, pol)
    assert got == expected, (got, expected)
    assert (req, ev, pol) == before
    assert set(got) == {'status','value','sources','unknowns'}

p={'required_conditions':['recipe','material'],'require_verified':False}
check({'claim':'x','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [], p, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['material']})
